description: This file contains a series of shell test scripts for testing the 'git show-branch' command and its various options and scenarios. It includes setup routines, error handling tests, output verification, and various command option combinations to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, runs the command scripts, and compares expected and actual outputs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, captures the error output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for verification.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or gets configuration values for testing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions after test case completes.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color-coded output for comparison purposes.

methods.name: test_orphan_error
methods.description: Checks error message when operating on orphan branches.
